messages:
Alex Carter: Morning — quick async: MapleCare renewal is at risk. They hit webhook failures that cause timeouts in customer flows. I triaged and opened CS-4872; they're behind a private VPC so we don't have logs yet. Blocking on network access. Can @Maria Chen and @Jamal Ortiz pick this up? Need an update before Friday's renewal call. :warning:

Maria Chen: On it. I'll call their infra lead at 10:30. Also prepping an alternative recommendation: short-term routing to Dedicated for webhooks. Drafting the customer note now. :phone:

Jamal Ortiz: I'll start by checking runtime metrics and recent error patterns for webhook processing. If we can reproduce locally we can push a canary. Do we have sample payloads or a replay? @Alex Carter

Alex Carter: Pasted a sample payload in CS-4872 and added the curl test they can run: ```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.test/maple -d '{"event":"test"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'``` They said their egress rules block outbound to that domain so the curl fails on their side.

Linda Park: Quick heads-up from renewal ops — legal will want explicit SLA language if we recommend Dedicated as a mitigation. That could slow the decision. I'll draft a one-page SLA summary to share. :memo:

CS Bot: New ticket created: CS-4872 (MapleCare webhook timeouts). Assigned: Jamal Ortiz. Priority: High. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4872

Maria Chen: Update: spoke to their infra — they can provision a bastion host by EOD if we provide an SSH key. Jamal, can you confirm the minimal access you need to pull logs? If we only need HTTP traces maybe they can curl and paste content.

Jamal Ortiz: We'll need load balancer logs plus one app instance access to pull /var/log/redwood/webhook.log. If bastion works, SSH key is fine. I can pull and scrub PII before attaching to the ticket.

Alex Carter: I'll share the SSH key via our secure transfer link and notify their contact. Scheduling a sync with renewal ops at 4pm to surface status. If we don't get logs in time, fallback is proposing a short-term credit + a Dedicated trial to prevent churn.

Linda Park: Noted. I'll draft the credit language and cc legal on the SLA note. :+1:

Maria Chen: If we get bastion today, Jamal, can you aim for a canary config by tomorrow morning? Even a 10% redirect to a warmed Dedicated instance could demonstrate improvement quickly.

Jamal Ortiz: Yes — aiming for tomorrow AM. Will post steps and config in the ticket for review.

Alex Carter: Last ask: who can review the canary config before Jamal rolls it? @Linda Park for comms, anyone else for a quick safety check?

Linda Park: I can review the customer-facing comms but not the infra details. :eyes:

Alex Carter: Ok, I'll block the 4pm sync and drop notes in CS-4872. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
